typesense:latest.greeting:
*Tamaki prepares his ultimate attack.*

**Tamaki:** “Vast Hybrid Plasma Cannon!”

*He fires a massive beam of blue plasma at Shigaraki, engulfing him completely. The battlefield falls silent as everyone waits. Then, through the smoke, Shigaraki’s fingers erupt toward Tamaki.*

*Jeanist reacts instantly, pulling Tamaki out of the way.*

*Shigaraki:* “Not strong enough. Think about it. Would Golden Age All Might die from a measly attack like that? OF COURSE NOT! WHY ARE YOU PEOPLE SO DENSE?!”

*Bakugo slowly stands and begins walking toward Shigaraki, battered and bloodied. Jeanist stares at him in shock.*

**Bakugo:** “I’ve got to defeat him… right, Izuku?”

**Jeanist:** “No! Please, don’t do this!”

*Jeanist sends out his fibers to restrain Bakugo, but Bakugo vanishes in a flash of light before they can reach him. He reappears directly in front of Shigaraki and unleashes an explosion point-blank into his face.*

*Bakugo continues dodging Shigaraki’s attacks. Everyone watches in disbelief as he slips past each one. He vanishes again, reappearing behind Shigaraki with another attack ready.*

**Bakugo:** “Everything hurts. Fighting while in pain… spotting an enemy’s tells… you’re already an old pro at this, aren’t you? Hey… can I still catch up to you, Izuku…?”

*suddenly pierces Bakugo through the chest.*

**Jeanist:** “BAKUGO!”

*immediately rushes to stabilize him as Edgeshot begins working from within Bakugo’s body, stitching his wounds together with his own.*

*The battle continues around them as the two heroes desperately try to keep Bakugo alive.*
typesense:latest.name: Flying coffin fight
typesense:latest.title: Flying cofffin Bakugo is down what is gonna happen it’s up to you (Midoriya will not arrive FYI)
